title: Full House
content: Full house, drinks flowing.
contentZh: 人很多，酒够喝。

title: Big Night
content: Pink pigs at the door. No one kept a straight face. Small place, big night.
contentZh: 门口粉猪，没人绷住。小地方，大晚上。

title: Miss You Already
content: Can't believe it's been this long. Will you come back? See you then.
contentZh: 竟然这么久了。还会回来吗？等你。

title: Thankful
content: Special birthday, special companies.
contentZh: 特别的日子，有你们在，就好。

title: With You
content: Glad you're here. Let's make this last.
contentZh: 你来了，就好。让此刻，慢些走。

title: Cheers to That
content: We are here, we are home, we are glad to have each other.
contentZh: 我们在，到家了，有彼此在，挺好。

title: Overshot
content: Rio to Shanghai, a chance crossing. More travels ahead. Have fun.
contentZh: 从里约到上海，一场意外的相遇。旅途还长，玩得开心哦。

title: Dancing on You
content: Dancing on you—my honor, your memory worth keeping.
contentZh: 在你身上起舞——是我的荣幸，也是你值得珍藏的回忆。

title: Hello Everyone
content: Three years in, still going strong.
contentZh: 相遇三年，历久弥坚。

title: Something Buried
content: Hard to believe it's been seven years. Time moves fast. We've changed, or maybe we haven't—who's to say?
contentZh: 七年没见，时间快得不像真的。我们变了，又好像没变——变没变呢，谁知道。

title: Happy Sandwich
content: To be greeted by Will and Daisuke like this—front and back, all at once—isn't something that happens every day.
contentZh: 想被白二和大介这样前拥后抱吗，这种机会可不是天天有哦。

title: Oh Santa!
content: Merry Christmas! Have anything in mind that you hope to get from Santa Robin?
contentZh: 圣诞快乐！有想从圣诞塔哥这里得到的礼物吗？

title: CF 4 Drink
content: Yes it's Christmas time. We train. We drink. Both, non-negotiable.
contentZh: 圣诞来了，我们CF小组，练是要练的，酒也是要喝的。

title: Aidan's Birthday
content: It's Aidan's birthday soon, he's so happy when he received this special gift.
contentZh: 老朋友Aidan要过生日啦，我们送了他一个特别的礼物，他开心坏了。

title: Big Guys Rule!
content: Another Saturday night, the big guys are in the house.
contentZh: 一个重量级选手云集的周六晚。

title: Woof Woof
content: DQ is an old friend of ours too. Even she's angling for a sip.
contentZh: DQ也是老朋友啦，就连她也想来上一口。

title: A Single Glance
content: One gaze, time stranded in the now.
contentZh: 一眼凝眸，时光便在此刻搁浅。

title: Unexpected Encounter
content: What beats seeing friends after a long day?
contentZh: 还有什么比忙碌了一天之后见到朋友们更令人开心的。

title: A Quiet Moment of Dex
content: Dex is a good friend of ours who's been dropping by most weeks lately. One evening before the heat set in, I caught this shot of him — ended up being one of his favorites too.
contentZh: Dex是我们的老朋友，近来几乎每周都会来。入夏前的某个夜晚，我随手按下快门，没想到定格了他最松弛的样子——他自己看了，也说喜欢。

title: Sunny Saucy, Fifty Shades of Grey
content: This Friday night, come and have a drink or much more, with Matthew, our latest one-night host.
contentZh: 本周五晚上，我们将迎来一日店长马修，来和他一醉方休吧！

title: Untold Surprise
content: What I didn't mention—Yida, our old friend who moved to Australia, is back in town after all this time.
contentZh: 我故意没说的是，今天好久没见的移居澳洲的朋友益达回来啦！非常开心！！

title: Happy Birthday
content: It's our best friend Robin's birthday. I'm sure it's not the right picture to post, but anyway haha.
contentZh: 今天是好朋友铁塔的生日，来一起祝他生日快乐吧！照片选的可能不太对，但……

title: Bubble Romance
content: I'm singing in the rain, and dancing in the rain.
contentZh: 你看，好多泡泡啊。
